text:
alina: Quick note from a pairing session with a new hire — several README snippets are out of sync and it's causing real onboarding pain. They hit: 401s from mixed header examples, JSON parse errors from missing Content-Type, and a mysterious validation error from an embeddings call that used `size` instead of `dimension`.

newhire: FWIW, I spent ~20min trying to debug a curl example that used `Authorization: Token` and then another that used `X-Api-Key`. Kept rotating env var names too. Super confusing.

jared: Oof. We standardized on `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY` and REDWOOD_API_KEY as the canonical env var. Looks like some archived READMEs still have the older patterns. Can you paste one of the broken examples?

alina: Sure — problematic curl I hit:
```bash
# bad
export REDWOOD_KEY=sk-REDACTED
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"messages":[]}'
# good
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-REDACTED
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[]}'
```

jared: Also check SDK snippets — I saw a Python example that reconstructs the client inside a retry loop. That caused socket churn in our test load. Should call out: create client once, reuse, then retry calls.

alina: Example (anti-pattern vs recommended):
```py
# bad - recreates client inside retry
for i in range(3):
    client = Client(token=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
    try:
        client.generate(...)
    except TransientError:
        sleep(1)
# good - create client once
client = Client(token=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
for i in range(3):
    try:
        client.generate(...)
    except TransientError:
        sleep(1)
```

newhire: The embeddings error was frustrating — docs show `size` in one place and `dimension` in another. The SDK validates and throws.

alina: Right. We'll unify on `dimension` and update quickstarts to reference model vector sizes. Example fix for embeddings curl:
```json
// bad
{"model":"old-embed","size":1536,"input":["a"]}
// good
{"model":"text-embed-1","dimension":1536,"input":["a"]}
```

docs-lint-bot: Suggested quick wins: add a docs CI grep for `X-Api-Key|Authorization:\s*Token|REDWOOD_KEY|\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]+\b|\bsize\s*:` inside fenced code blocks. Also flag `new Client` inside loops. Filed lint proposal doc.

ci-bot: I can add a lightweight docs job that scans markdown fenced code blocks for those regexes and fails CI on matches. Will add to docs workflow as `docs/snippet-scan`. Reminder: docs-only PR template requires linking to an issue and a changelog line.

jared: Great. Plan: alina will open a small PR to: (1) standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY across quickstarts and sample-app READMEs, (2) replace deprecated headers (`X-Api-Key`, `Authorization: Token`) with `Authorization: Bearer` and always include Content-Type in curl blocks, (3) fix embeddings `size` -> `dimension` and update model name to `text-embed-1`, (4) fix Python/Node examples to show client reuse and mention top-level await caveat for Node.

alina: I'll include a grep run in the PR checklist and reference a new issue for the docs linter. Tagging @jared for SDK snippet review. :sparkles:

newhire: Thanks — these changes would have saved me a bunch of time. Happy to sanity-check once the PR lands.

ci-bot: Issue #5250 created for docs lint + snippet-scan. Please include `fixes #5250` in the PR description to auto-close the tracking issue.

jared: Thanks. Small fixes but high impact for onboarding. :+1:
